description.title: Team Building Above the Ordinary
description.paragraph: Plan a balloon experience over Teotihuacán for your team, event or group. Tell Flying Pictures about your guests, flight arrangement, transport and services; the offer and price are defined in your quote.

steps.title: Tell us about your event
steps.description: Share your preferred date, guest count and the purpose of the visit.

steps.title: Choose the services
steps.description: Discuss flight arrangements, transport and activities for your group.

steps.title: Receive your quote
steps.description: Confirm the scope of services and the total price.

steps.title: Coordinate your visit
steps.description: We agree on availability, timing and the meeting point.
